question_answered: Are the instance and physics exactly identified?
required_evidence: Manifest hashes plus schema and physical-input validation

question_answered: Is the LP over the combined-cost route representation certified?
required_evidence: Exact-pricer termination with no negative reduced-cost column plus durable telemetry
claim_allowed: Certified combined-cost LP bound for the named representation
claim_not_allowed: Full fleet-model LP or integer optimality

question_answered: Is the fleet-objective LP bound certified over the full named route representation?
required_evidence: Fleet-objective column generation plus exact no-improving-column certificate

question_answered: Is there a valid same-model integer schedule with a stated fleet value?
required_evidence: Integer incumbent plus independent route coverage charging tariff and SOC replay
claim_allowed: A valid upper bound on I_model

question_answered: Do a certified LP lower bound and valid integer upper bound meet?
required_evidence: S2 lower bound equals S3 integer fleet value within declared tolerance
claim_allowed: I_model is proved for the named representation
claim_not_allowed: Optimality for different physics or representation

question_answered: What is the best/proved integer solution over the frozen CG column pool?
required_evidence: Hashed frozen pool plus validated timed or exact MIP artifact

question_answered: Is the finite-pool MIP optimum proved?
required_evidence: S5 solve with matching lower and upper bounds and validated physical witness
claim_allowed: I_pool is proved for that exact pool
claim_not_allowed: I_model unless the S4 sandwich is also present

question_answered: What changes under a fixed-duty or DR policy?
required_evidence: A locked policy definition and full S0-S6 provenance for each comparison
claim_not_allowed: Transfer to another policy or physics
